title: Smoothed nearest-key target features -- full 5-fold promotion gate (completion of the fold-0 PATH)
why_new_prereg: The fold-0 prereg explicitly scoped itself to fold 0 ('a PATH verdict only recommends folds 1-4 for FUTURE consideration and does NOT launch them'). This prereg freezes the folds 1-4 completion BEFORE any folds 1-4 treatment evaluation. Historical preregs are never edited; this is a separate frozen contract for the promotion gate.

multi_fidelity_rationale.fold0_screen: DONE -- PATH_TO_REPLICATION (cheap single-fold screen; mechanism confirmed by unique-key concentration)
multi_fidelity_rationale.this_step: 5-fold promotion gate on the SAME control/treatment member -- the completion the fold-0 prereg anticipated. Cheap (~15 min CPU) and de-risks the expensive portfolio deployment (which requires surgery on the certified aux trainer).
multi_fidelity_rationale.next_step_if_pass: portfolio-level deployment: add the nk block to ALL 10 aux members, rebuild OOF, measure the v7 portfolio delta vs the current champion -- a separate, heavier, separately-preregistered experiment. NOT launched by this prereg.

scope.outer_eval: OOF over all 5 primary folds (k=0..4); for each k, fit on folds!=k, eval on fold k
scope.submission_budget_note: 0 of 2 final submissions used; none authorized by this prereg

anti_leakage.primary: No eval-fold label in any supervised fit (features, targets, early-stopping).
anti_leakage.rich_view_te: ViewBuilder.assemble(fi=folds!=k, y, val=fold k, inner_seed=MEMBER_SEED) rebuilds the fold-safe TE per fold using ONLY the fit rows' labels (the certified fold-safe assembly used by run_views).
anti_leakage.nk_block: NearestKeyTE.crossfit(fit_key_folds!=k, y[folds!=k], fit_R) encodes FIT rows with an inner 5-fold cross-fit (no row sees its own label); NearestKeyTE.apply(fit_key_folds!=k, y[folds!=k], apply_key_foldk, apply_R_foldk) encodes fold-k rows from the FIT table ONLY (fold-k labels never read).
anti_leakage.early_stopping: _inner_es_split(fit, y, seed=1) carves the inner ES split from the FIT rows (folds!=k) ONLY, never the eval fold -- identical for control and treatment so the ONLY difference is the nk block.
anti_leakage.segment_flags: unique/dup rating-key flags are transductive + LABEL-free (value_counts over combined tr+te ratings, atlas is_dup definition). Permitted (cnt_* transductive class).
anti_leakage.forbidden: Atlas difficulty diagnostics, any fold-k label in features/targets/ES, public-leaderboard-based selection, changing decision rules after results, retuning nk smoothing params (lam/min_count) after results.

members.control: LightGBM, rich view 'full', WITHOUT the nk feature block
members.treatment: identical LightGBM, rich view 'full', WITH the nk feature block appended
identical_between: rich view 'full' base features (fold-safe per fold)
inner ES split (same trn/es for control+treatment)
members.only_difference: presence of the 3 nk columns (crossfit for FIT rows, apply for eval-fold rows)
members.params_note: same MEMBER_PARAMS as the fold-0 screen and H19-A (rich view + extra_trees verified +2.75e-4 on the full view). extra_trees=True is valid ONLY on a rich view -- it is on one here.
members.early_stopping: inner 10% split carved from FIT rows ONLY, patience 300; never the eval fold (keeps OOF comparable with itself)

features.base: ViewBuilder(tr, te, 'full') -- rich view, 285 features (raw21 + coarse10 + fold-safe transductive/external/te blocks)

nk_block.params_frozen: identical to the fold-0 screen; NO smoothing sweep after results
nk_block.encoding: base-6 over the 13 integer ratings; Hamming-distance-1 neighbor keys via src/phase20/h19c_nearest_key.py

metrics.primary: per-fold member AUC (control, treatment), paired delta_k = treat_k - ctrl_k for k=0..4
metrics.segments: per-fold AUC control/treatment/delta on unique_rating_key and dup_rating_key subsets (mechanism confirmation: gain should concentrate on unique keys)
metrics.correlations: per-fold Pearson of treatment vs champion route and aux halves (diversity signal)

portfolio_proxy_informational.composition: aux11=(10*aux0_k + member_logit)/11; port=sigmoid((logit(route_k)+aux11)/2), per fold k
portfolio_proxy_informational.status: INFORMATIONAL ONLY -- the 11th-member proxy UNDERWEIGHTS a feature block (enters at weight 1/11); it is NOT the gate quantity. Reported to show direction, not used for the decision.

metrics.champion_reference: phase17_B1 per-fold route/portfolio npy, hash-asserted (CHAMPION_PORTFOLIO_SHA256 / CHAMPION_ROUTE_SHA256); aux0_k logits from classical(k, ...) (fold-k-safe: trains/loads only folds!=k members); composition bit-exact vs stored portfolio

decision_rules.gate_type: MEMBER-LEVEL promotion gate (a necessary condition for the feature; the portfolio deployment is the further, separately-preregistered step)
decision_rules.PROMOTE: all three gate conditions met -> nk is a validated member-level improvement; RECOMMEND the portfolio-level deployment test (nk added to all 10 aux members) as the next separately-preregistered experiment. Does NOT auto-launch it.
decision_rules.DEAD: mean_paired_delta <= 0, OR positive_fold_count <= 2 (mechanism does not replicate beyond fold 0) -> record NEGATIVE for this exact mechanism (lam/min_count/base-6/Hamming-1); do not rerun identically; any future retry must change a predeclared mechanism (different radius, key definition, or estimator), not retune lam/min_count.
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: everything else (some gate conditions met, mixed folds, or sub-threshold mean) -> no promotion, mechanism not falsified; may be revisited only with a genuinely new angle, not a retune.
decision_rules.no_lmbd_sweep: lam=30.0 and min_count=2 are frozen; a post-hoc smoothing sweep on these folds is forbidden.

forbidden: rerunning the identical recipe after a DEAD verdict
editing the fold-0 prereg or its result
